gaps: Public search is deferred because the browser-rendered search flow does not provide a stable credential-free API contract.
Authenticated recipe collections, personal meal plans, and account mutations are outside the public release scope.

novel_features.name: Multi-Recipe Ingredient Plan
novel_features.description: Combine ingredients from multiple public Cookidoo recipes into one structured plan for review and shopping handoff.
novel_features.rationale: Cookidoo's public recipe pages return one recipe at a time; the CLI fetches and normalizes several recipes locally to produce a combined ingredient plan that no single API response provides.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use this when an agent needs one reviewable ingredient list for several selected recipes before a separate shopping search.

narrative.headline: Read-only Cookidoo CLI for public recipe details and local recipe analysis.
narrative.value_prop: Fetch public recipe details and normalize ingredients and nutrition for agents and scripts. Combine several recipes into one ingredient plan without accessing a Cookidoo account or changing a meal plan.
narrative.auth_narrative: Public recipe lookup does not use Cookidoo credentials. Authenticated account actions and personal meal-plan access are outside this CLI's public scope.

quickstart.comment: Start with structured details for a public recipe.
Combine ingredients from selected public recipes into one plan.

troubleshoots.fix: Use a public Cookidoo recipe ID such as r68517 or a public recipe URL.

troubleshoots.symptom: A locale-specific recipe page cannot be found
troubleshoots.fix: Pass the recipe's locale with --locale, for example --locale pt-BR.

narrative.when_to_use: Use this CLI to retrieve public recipe details, ingredients, or nutrition as structured output, or to combine several public recipes into a machine-readable ingredient plan. Use a separate shopping CLI only when you want to search a retailer catalog and review the resulting candidates.
anti_triggers: Authenticated Cookidoo account data or personal meal plans
Adding or removing recipes from a Cookidoo week
Purchases, cart changes, or recipe search requiring browser-only credentials
